"""Frozen-recipe independent-trajectory accuracy evaluator; no tuning.

Preparation is stdlib-only. Numerical stages require an exclusive free workload
slot and run only in strict pre-import-bootstrapped subprocesses. Outputs are
exclusive; failures and partial forecast ledgers are retained, never retried.
"""

from __future__ import annotations
import argparse, datetime, hashlib, importlib.metadata, importlib.util, io, json, math, os, platform, random, shutil, statistics, subprocess, sys, tarfile, time, traceback, warnings
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def digest(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()


def canonical(value):
    return digest(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False).encode())


def write(path, value):
    with path.open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")


def manifest(path):
    return {
        p.relative_to(path).as_posix(): digest(p.read_bytes())
        for p in sorted(path.rglob("*"))
        if p.is_file() and "__pycache__" not in p.parts and p.suffix != ".pyc"
    }


def condition():
    result = {
        "utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "pid": os.getpid(),
        "loadavg": list(os.getloadavg()),
    }
    for name, args in [
        ("thermal", ["pmset", "-g", "therm"]),
        ("power", ["pmset", "-g", "batt"]),
    ]:
        p = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
        result[name] = {
            "returncode": p.returncode,
            "stdout": p.stdout,
            "stderr": p.stderr,
        }
    return result


def prepare(args):
    root = args.repository.resolve()
    out = args.directory.resolve()
    out.mkdir()
    plan = json.loads((BASE / "study-plan-proposal.json").read_text())
    for relative, entry in plan["recipe_sources"].items():
        if digest((root / relative).read_bytes()) != entry["sha256"]:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Original recipe publication changed before preregistration"
            )
    commit = subprocess.check_output(
        [
            "git",
            "rev-parse",
            "HEAD" if args.source_ref == "WORKTREE" else args.source_ref,
        ],
        cwd=root,
        text=True,
    ).strip()
    if args.source_ref == "WORKTREE":
        shutil.copytree(
            root / "src/resdag",
            out / "source/src/resdag",
            ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "*.pyc"),
        )
    else:
        payload = subprocess.check_output(
            ["git", "archive", commit, "src/resdag"], cwd=root
        )
        with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(payload)) as archive:
            for entry in archive.getmembers():
                parts = Path(entry.name).parts
                if (
                    ".." in parts
                    or Path(entry.name).is_absolute()
                    or not (entry.isfile() or entry.isdir())
                ):
                    raise ValueError("Unsafe Git archive")
                target = out / "source" / entry.name
                if entry.isdir():
                    target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                else:
                    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    with target.open("xb") as stream:
                        stream.write(archive.extractfile(entry).read())
    runner = out / "runner"
    runner.mkdir()
    for name in ["tuned_accuracy.py", "accuracy_regression.py"]:
        shutil.copyfile(root / "benchmarks" / name, runner / name)
    shutil.copytree(
        root / "benchmarks/rc_bench",
        runner / "rc_bench",
        ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "*.pyc"),
    )
    shutil.copyfile(Path(__file__), runner / "evaluate.py")
    plan["status"] = "APPROVED six-recipe design; frozen before any ODE/model data"
    write(out / "approved-design.json", plan)
    (out / "recipe-sources").mkdir()
    for relative in plan["recipe_sources"]:
        shutil.copyfile(root / relative, out / "recipe-sources" / Path(relative).name)
    recipes = {key: value for key, value in plan["recipes"].items()}
    for value in recipes.values():
        if value["panel"] == "recommended-secondary-context":
            value["panel"] = "secondary-common-state-only"
    trajectories = []
    for system, seed in [("lorenz", 2026102306), ("rossler", 2026102307)]:
        rng = random.Random(seed)
        for index in range(5):
            trajectories.append(
                {
                    "id": f"{system}-ic{index}",
                    "system": system,
                    "ic_index": index,
                    "ic_generator_seed": seed,
                    "initial_condition": [rng.uniform(0.5, 1.5) for _ in range(3)],
                }
            )
    for name in ["data", "weights", "checkpoints", "predictions", "processes"]:
        (out / name).mkdir()
    source = manifest(out / "source")
    helpers = manifest(runner)
    protocol = {
        "schema": "resdag-independent-trajectories-v1",
        "status": "PREREGISTERED BEFORE DATA",
        "created_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "source_ref": args.source_ref,
        "source_commit": commit,
        "source_manifest": source,
        "source_manifest_sha256": canonical(source),
        "runner_manifest": helpers,
        "runner_manifest_sha256": canonical(helpers),
        "recipe_sources": plan["recipe_sources"],
        "recipes": recipes,
        "recipe_manifest_sha256": canonical(recipes),
        "trajectories": trajectories,
        "initialization_seeds": [5849201, 5849202, 5849203],
        "data_protocols": plan["data_protocols"],
        "metric": plan["metric"],
        "failure_policy": plan["failure_policy_proposal"],
        "scope": "Six fixed recipes; four primary SVD capability and two secondary Gaussian/Ridge common state-only. Refit each trajectory training prefix; no tuning/reselection. Torch CPU float64 eager only. Timings are context, not performance evidence.",
        "concurrency_boundary": "Accuracy execution may overlap parent correctness tests or package/build checks after performance measurements finish. Wall/process times are context only, not latency evidence.",
        "worker_timeout_seconds": 3600,
        "expected_counts": {
            "systems": 2,
            "trajectories": 10,
            "recipes": 6,
            "fits": 90,
            "individual_forecasts": 270,
            "individual_forecasts_per_recipe": 45,
        },
        "source_worktree_diff": (
            subprocess.check_output(
                ["git", "diff", "--", "src/resdag"], cwd=root, text=True
            )
            if args.source_ref == "WORKTREE"
            else ""
        ),
    }
    write(out / "preregistered.json", protocol)
    write(
        out / "preregistration-receipt.json",
        {
            "sha256": digest((out / "preregistered.json").read_bytes()),
            "data_files_created": False,
            "numerical_modules_imported": [
                m for m in ["numpy", "scipy", "torch", "resdag"] if m in sys.modules
            ],
        },
    )
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "directory": str(out),
                "preregistered_sha256": digest(
                    (out / "preregistered.json").read_bytes()
                ),
                "source_manifest_sha256": protocol["source_manifest_sha256"],
                "next": "Review frozen source/recipes/ICs, then run the copied runner/evaluate.py --stage run --directory OUTPUT only after numerical authorization.",
            }
        ),
        flush=True,
    )


def load_helper(path, name):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def tensors(module):
    values = {}
    for name, value in list(module.named_parameters()) + list(module.named_buffers()):
        value = value.detach().cpu()
        if str(value.layout) != "torch.strided":
            value = value.to_dense()
        values[name] = {
            "shape": list(value.shape),
            "dtype": str(value.dtype),
            "sha256": digest(value.contiguous().numpy().tobytes()),
        }
    return {"tensors": values, "sha256": canonical(values)}


def tensor_fp(value):
    value = value.detach().cpu().contiguous()
    return {
        "shape": list(value.shape),
        "dtype": str(value.dtype),
        "sha256": digest(value.numpy().tobytes()),
    }


def build_common(rd, torch, params, seed, Gaussian, radius):
    inp = rd.reservoir_input(3, dtype=torch.float64)
    res = rd.ESNLayer(
        params["reservoir_size"],
        feedback_size=3,
        recurrent_initializer=Gaussian(
            params["mean_degree"] / params["reservoir_size"]
        ),
        spectral_radius=radius,
        leak_rate=params["leak_rate"],
        feedback_initializer=("uniform", {"input_scaling": params["input_scaling"]}),
        bias=True,
        bias_scaling=params["bias_scaling"],
        bias_initializer=("uniform", {"input_scaling": params["bias_scaling"]}),
        seed=seed,
        dtype=torch.float64,
        sparse=False,
    )(inp)
    head = rd.RidgeReadoutLayer(
        params["reservoir_size"], 3, alpha=params["alpha"], bias=False, name="output"
    ).double()
    return rd.ESNModel(inp, head(res)).eval()


def construct(rd, torch, helper, Gaussian, recipe, seed, reference):
    params = recipe["params"]
    if recipe["family"] == "common-state-only":
        return build_common(
            rd,
            torch,
            params,
            seed,
            Gaussian,
            params["spectral_radius"] if reference else None,
        )
    return helper._build(
        rd,
        torch,
        recipe["family"],
        params if reference else dict(params, rho=None),
        seed,
    )


def timed(fn, threads):
    threads.verify_thread_policy()
    wall = time.perf_counter()
    cpu = time.process_time()
    value = fn()
    cpu = time.process_time() - cpu
    wall = time.perf_counter() - wall
    threads.verify_thread_policy()
    return value, {
        "wall_seconds": wall,
        "process_cpu_seconds": cpu,
        "cpu_wall_ratio": cpu / wall,
    }


def generate(out, protocol, np, torch, rd, helper, threads):
    import inspect
    import tsdynamics as ts

    if importlib.metadata.version("tsdynamics") != "6.0.3":
        raise RuntimeError("Preregistered generator version is TSDynamics6.0.3")
    records = []
    for trajectory in protocol["trajectories"]:
        system = trajectory["system"]
        config = protocol["data_protocols"][system]
        count = config["test"][1]
        discard = config["discard_samples"]
        dt = config["dt"]
        dynamics = (
            ts.systems.Lorenz(sigma=10.0, rho=28.0, beta=8 / 3)
            if system == "lorenz"
            else ts.systems.Rossler(a=0.2, b=0.2, c=5.7)
        )
        result, timing = timed(
            lambda: dynamics.run(
                final_time=(count + discard) * dt,
                dt=dt,
                ic=trajectory["initial_condition"],
                solver="dop853",
                rtol=1e-10,
                atol=1e-12,
            ),
            threads,
        )
        raw = np.ascontiguousarray(
            result.y[discard : discard + count], dtype=np.float64
        )
        times = np.ascontiguousarray(
            result.t[discard : discard + count], dtype=np.float64
        )
        if (
            raw.shape != (count, 3)
            or times.shape != (count,)
            or not np.isfinite(raw).all()
            or not np.isfinite(times).all()
        ):
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Invalid generated trajectory; no IC replacement allowed"
            )
        if not np.allclose(
            np.diff(times),
            dt,
            rtol=0,
            atol=64 * np.finfo(np.float64).eps * max(1, float(np.abs(times).max())),
        ):
            raise RuntimeError("Generated time grid differs")
        values_path = out / "data" / f"{trajectory['id']}.npy"
        time_path = out / "data" / f"{trajectory['id']}-times.npy"
        for path, array in [(values_path, raw), (time_path, times)]:
            with path.open("xb") as stream:
                np.save(stream, array, allow_pickle=False)
        source = Path(inspect.getsourcefile(type(dynamics)))
        records.append(
            {
                "trajectory": trajectory,
                "config": config,
                "shape": list(raw.shape),
                "values_path": str(values_path.relative_to(out)),
                "values_sha256": digest(raw.tobytes()),
                "file_sha256": digest(values_path.read_bytes()),
                "time_path": str(time_path.relative_to(out)),
                "times_sha256": digest(times.tobytes()),
                "time_file_sha256": digest(time_path.read_bytes()),
                "first_time": float(times[0]),
                "last_time": float(times[-1]),
                "generation_timing": timing,
                "generator_version": importlib.metadata.version("tsdynamics"),
                "generator_source_file": str(source),
                "generator_source_sha256": digest(source.read_bytes()),
                "parameters": repr(dynamics),
            }
        )
        print("generated", trajectory["id"], flush=True)
    write(
        out / "data-manifest.json",
        {
            "records": records,
            "preregistered_sha256": digest((out / "preregistered.json").read_bytes()),
            "all_data_sealed_before_fitting": True,
        },
    )
    return records


def weights(out, protocol, np, torch, rd, helper, threads):
    from rc_bench.budget_adapters import GaussianRecurrent

    records = {}
    for name, recipe in protocol["recipes"].items():
        for seed in protocol["initialization_seeds"]:
            key = f"{name}-seed{seed}"
            torch.manual_seed(918273)
            try:
                model, timing = timed(
                    lambda: construct(
                        rd, torch, helper, GaussianRecurrent, recipe, seed, True
                    ),
                    threads,
                )
                initial = tensors(model)
                path = out / "weights" / f"{key}.pt"
                with path.open("xb") as stream:
                    torch.save(model.state_dict(), stream)
                records[key] = {
                    "path": str(path.relative_to(out)),
                    "file_sha256": digest(path.read_bytes()),
                    "initial_fingerprint": initial,
                    "construction": timing,
                }
            except (threads.ThreadPolicyError, OSError):
                raise
            except Exception as exc:
                records[key] = {
                    "failure": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}",
                    "traceback": traceback.format_exc(),
                }
            print(
                "weights",
                key,
                "ok" if "failure" not in records[key] else "FAILED",
                flush=True,
            )
    write(
        out / "weight-manifest.json",
        {
            "records": records,
            "recipes_sha256": protocol["recipe_manifest_sha256"],
            "data_manifest_sha256": digest((out / "data-manifest.json").read_bytes()),
        },
    )
    return records


def evaluate(out, protocol, np, torch, rd, helper, threads, trajectory_id):
    from rc_bench.budget_adapters import GaussianRecurrent
    from rc_bench.adapters.resdag_adapter import ResdagCPUAdapter
    from rc_bench.config import Point
    from rc_bench.metrics import valid_prediction_time
    from resdag.hpo._tuning_scores import score_forecast

    trajectory = next(t for t in protocol["trajectories"] if t["id"] == trajectory_id)
    system = trajectory["system"]
    config = protocol["data_protocols"][system]
    data_manifest = json.loads((out / "data-manifest.json").read_text())
    record = next(
        r for r in data_manifest["records"] if r["trajectory"]["id"] == trajectory_id
    )
    path = out / record["values_path"]
    if digest(path.read_bytes()) != record["file_sha256"]:
        raise RuntimeError("Data artifact changed")
    raw_np = np.load(path, allow_pickle=False)
    raw = torch.from_numpy(raw_np.copy())
    train_stop = config["training"][1]
    training = raw[:train_stop].clone()
    scales = training[501:].std(dim=0, correction=0)
    scales = torch.where(
        scales == 0,
        torch.ones_like(scales),
        scales.clamp_min(torch.finfo(torch.float64).eps),
    )
    normal_rows = raw_np[501:train_stop]
    mean = normal_rows.mean(axis=0)
    std = normal_rows.std(axis=0)
    std = np.where(std == 0, 1.0, std)
    normalized = np.ascontiguousarray((raw_np - mean) / std, dtype=np.float64)
    weight_manifest = json.loads((out / "weight-manifest.json").read_text())
    if (
        weight_manifest["data_manifest_sha256"]
        != digest((out / "data-manifest.json").read_bytes())
        or weight_manifest["recipes_sha256"] != protocol["recipe_manifest_sha256"]
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Sealed data/recipe manifest binding changed")
    if data_manifest["preregistered_sha256"] != digest(
        (out / "preregistered.json").read_bytes()
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Data were generated under another preregistration")
    manifest_weights = weight_manifest["records"]
    rows = []
    fits = []
    ledger = (out / "processes" / f"{trajectory_id}-forecasts.jsonl").open("x")
    try:
        for name, recipe in protocol["recipes"].items():
            if not name.startswith(system + "-"):
                continue
            for seed in protocol["initialization_seeds"]:
                key = f"{name}-seed{seed}"
                fit_id = f"{trajectory_id}-{key}"
                entry = manifest_weights[key]
                fit = {
                    "id": fit_id,
                    "recipe": name,
                    "trajectory": trajectory_id,
                    "seed": seed,
                }
                model = None
                fit_error = None
                if "failure" in entry:
                    fit_error = "initialization failed: " + entry["failure"]
                    fit["status"] = "initialization_failed"
                    fit["failure"] = fit_error
                else:
                    weight_path = out / entry["path"]
                    if digest(weight_path.read_bytes()) != entry["file_sha256"]:
                        raise RuntimeError("Weight artifact changed")
                    torch.manual_seed(918273)
                    model = construct(
                        rd, torch, helper, GaussianRecurrent, recipe, seed, False
                    )
                    model.load_state_dict(
                        torch.load(weight_path, weights_only=True), strict=True
                    )
                    if tensors(model) != entry["initial_fingerprint"]:
                        raise RuntimeError(
                            "Loaded initial weights differ across trajectories"
                        )
                    fit["initial_fingerprint"] = entry["initial_fingerprint"]["sha256"]
                    fit["placeholder_policy"] = (
                        "spectral_radius=None only for disposable construction before strict stored-weight load"
                    )
                    try:
                        if recipe["family"] == "common-state-only":
                            point = Point(
                                reservoir_size=recipe["params"]["reservoir_size"],
                                train_len=train_stop - 1,
                                warmup=500,
                                horizon=1,
                            )
                            _, timing = timed(
                                lambda: ResdagCPUAdapter()._fit(
                                    model, torch.float64, normalized[:train_stop], point
                                ),
                                threads,
                            )
                        else:
                            _, timing = timed(lambda: model.fit(training), threads)
                    except (threads.ThreadPolicyError, OSError):
                        raise
                    except Exception as exc:
                        fit_error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
                        fit.update(
                            status="fit_failed",
                            failure=fit_error,
                            traceback=traceback.format_exc(),
                        )
                    else:
                        fit.update(
                            status="complete",
                            timing=timing,
                            fitted_fingerprint=tensors(model),
                        )
                        checkpoint = out / "checkpoints" / f"{fit_id}.pt"
                        with checkpoint.open("xb") as stream:
                            torch.save(model.state_dict(), stream)
                        fit["checkpoint"] = {
                            "path": str(checkpoint.relative_to(out)),
                            "sha256": digest(checkpoint.read_bytes()),
                        }
                fits.append(fit)
                for origin_id, origin in enumerate(config["test_origins"]):
                    identifier = f"{fit_id}-origin{origin_id}"
                    row = {
                        "id": identifier,
                        "fit_id": fit_id,
                        "system": system,
                        "recipe": name,
                        "panel": recipe["panel"],
                        "trajectory": trajectory_id,
                        "ic_index": trajectory["ic_index"],
                        "seed": seed,
                        "origin_id": origin_id,
                        "origin": origin,
                        "horizon": config["horizon_steps"],
                        "training_scale": scales.tolist(),
                        "scores": {},
                    }
                    prediction = None
                    if fit_error:
                        row.update(status="fit_failed", failure=fit_error)
                    else:
                        try:
                            if recipe["family"] == "common-state-only":
                                model.reset_reservoirs()
                                history = torch.from_numpy(
                                    normalized[origin - 500 : origin].copy()
                                ).unsqueeze(0)
                                prediction, timing = timed(
                                    lambda: model.forecast(
                                        history,
                                        horizon=config["horizon_steps"],
                                        compile=False,
                                    ),
                                    threads,
                                )
                                prediction = prediction.squeeze(0) * torch.from_numpy(
                                    std
                                ) + torch.from_numpy(mean)
                                row["history_steps"] = 500
                                row["model_normalization"] = {
                                    "mean": mean.tolist(),
                                    "scale": std.tolist(),
                                    "fit_rows": [501, train_stop],
                                }
                            else:
                                history = raw[:origin].clone()
                                prediction, timing = timed(
                                    lambda: model.forecast(
                                        history=history,
                                        horizon=config["horizon_steps"],
                                        compile=False,
                                    ),
                                    threads,
                                )
                                row["history_steps"] = origin
                            if prediction.shape != (config["horizon_steps"], 3):
                                raise ValueError("Wrong forecast shape")
                            row.update(
                                status=(
                                    "complete"
                                    if bool(torch.isfinite(prediction).all())
                                    else "diverged"
                                ),
                                timing=timing,
                                prediction=tensor_fp(prediction),
                                final_state={
                                    k: tensor_fp(v)
                                    for k, v in model.get_state().items()
                                },
                            )
                            path = out / "predictions" / f"{identifier}.npy"
                            with path.open("xb") as stream:
                                np.save(
                                    stream,
                                    prediction.detach().numpy(),
                                    allow_pickle=False,
                                )
                            row["prediction_file"] = {
                                "path": str(path.relative_to(out)),
                                "sha256": digest(path.read_bytes()),
                            }
                        except (threads.ThreadPolicyError, OSError):
                            raise
                        except Exception as exc:
                            row.update(
                                status="forecast_failed",
                                failure=f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}",
                                traceback=traceback.format_exc(),
                            )
                            prediction = None
                    truth = raw[origin : origin + config["horizon_steps"]]
                    for threshold in [0.3, 0.5]:
                        score = 0
                        library_error = None
                        nrmse = None
                        if prediction is not None:
                            p = prediction.detach().numpy()
                            target = truth.numpy()
                            with np.errstate(
                                over="ignore", invalid="ignore", divide="ignore"
                            ):
                                score = valid_prediction_time(
                                    p, target, threshold, scale=scales.numpy()
                                )
                                oracle = helper.HELPERS._independent_horizon(
                                    p, target, scales.numpy(), threshold
                                )
                            if score != oracle:
                                raise RuntimeError(
                                    "Independent first-crossing oracle disagreement"
                                )
                            if row["status"] == "complete":
                                try:
                                    native = score_forecast(
                                        {"prediction": prediction},
                                        {"prediction": truth},
                                        {"prediction": scales},
                                        threshold=threshold,
                                    )
                                except ValueError as exc:
                                    library_error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
                                else:
                                    if native.score != score:
                                        raise RuntimeError(
                                            "Native finite score disagrees"
                                        )
                                    nrmse = float(native.nrmse)
                                    if not math.isfinite(nrmse):
                                        nrmse = None
                        row["scores"][str(threshold)] = {
                            "steps": score,
                            "lyapunov_times": score
                            * config["dt"]
                            * config["lambda_max"],
                            "right_censored": score == config["horizon_steps"],
                            "full_horizon_nrmse": nrmse,
                            "library_score_error": library_error,
                        }
                    rows.append(row)
                    ledger.write(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                    ledger.flush()
                print("evaluated", fit_id, fit["status"], flush=True)
    finally:
        ledger.close()
    return {
        "rows": rows,
        "fits": fits,
        "data_manifest_sha256": digest((out / "data-manifest.json").read_bytes()),
        "weight_manifest_sha256": digest((out / "weight-manifest.json").read_bytes()),
    }


def worker(args):
    out = args.directory.resolve()
    sys.path.insert(0, str(out / "runner"))
    threads = load_helper(
        out / "runner/rc_bench/_threads.py", "frozen_accuracy_threads"
    )
    threads.bootstrap_cli()
    os.environ["TQDM_DISABLE"] = "1"
    protocol = json.loads((out / "preregistered.json").read_text())
    preregistered_sha = digest((out / "preregistered.json").read_bytes())
    if (
        preregistered_sha
        != json.loads((out / "preregistration-receipt.json").read_text())["sha256"]
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Original preregistration was edited")
    if canonical(protocol["recipes"]) != protocol["recipe_manifest_sha256"]:
        raise RuntimeError("Recipe manifest differs")
    if (
        manifest(out / "source") != protocol["source_manifest"]
        or manifest(out / "runner") != protocol["runner_manifest"]
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Frozen source/helper changed")
    result = {
        "stage": args.stage,
        "trajectory": args.trajectory,
        "preregistered_sha256": preregistered_sha,
        "start_condition": condition(),
        "timing_boundary": protocol["concurrency_boundary"],
    }
    sys.path.insert(0, str(out / "source/src"))
    caught = []
    try:
        with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
            warnings.simplefilter("always")
            with threads.single_thread_policy() as policy:
                import numpy as np
                import scipy
                import torch
                import resdag as rd

                helper = load_helper(
                    out / "runner/tuned_accuracy.py", "frozen_tuned_accuracy"
                )
                result["native_policy"] = policy
                result["versions"] = {
                    "python": sys.version,
                    "platform": platform.platform(),
                    "torch": torch.__version__,
                    "numpy": np.__version__,
                    "scipy": scipy.__version__,
                    "resdag": rd.__version__,
                }
                with torch.no_grad():
                    if args.stage == "generate":
                        result["records"] = generate(
                            out, protocol, np, torch, rd, helper, threads
                        )
                    elif args.stage == "weights":
                        result["records"] = weights(
                            out, protocol, np, torch, rd, helper, threads
                        )
                    else:
                        result.update(
                            evaluate(
                                out,
                                protocol,
                                np,
                                torch,
                                rd,
                                helper,
                                threads,
                                args.trajectory,
                            )
                        )
                threads.verify_thread_policy()
                result["import_origins"] = {
                    k: str(Path(v.__file__).resolve())
                    for k, v in sys.modules.items()
                    if (k == "resdag" or k.startswith("resdag."))
                    and getattr(v, "__file__", None)
                }
                if any(
                    not Path(p).is_relative_to(out / "source/src")
                    for p in result["import_origins"].values()
                ):
                    raise RuntimeError("Mixed runtime origins")
            result["warnings"] = [
                {
                    "category": w.category.__name__,
                    "message": str(w.message),
                    "filename": w.filename,
                    "lineno": w.lineno,
                }
                for w in caught
            ]
        if (
            manifest(out / "source") != protocol["source_manifest"]
            or manifest(out / "runner") != protocol["runner_manifest"]
            or digest((out / "preregistered.json").read_bytes()) != preregistered_sha
        ):
            raise RuntimeError("Frozen artifacts changed during worker")
        result["end_condition"] = condition()
        write(out / "processes" / f"{args.trajectory or args.stage}.json", result)
    except BaseException as error:
        result["status"] = "infrastructure_failure_or_aborted"
        result["failure"] = {
            "type": type(error).__name__,
            "message": str(error),
            "traceback": traceback.format_exc(),
        }
        result["warnings"] = [
            {
                "category": w.category.__name__,
                "message": str(w.message),
                "filename": w.filename,
                "lineno": w.lineno,
            }
            for w in caught
        ]
        result["failure_utc"] = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
        write(
            out / "processes" / f"{args.trajectory or args.stage}-failure.json", result
        )
        raise


def summarize(rows):
    result = []
    for recipe in sorted({r["recipe"] for r in rows}):
        chosen = [r for r in rows if r["recipe"] == recipe]
        record = {
            "recipe": recipe,
            "panel": chosen[0]["panel"],
            "count": len(chosen),
            "failed_forecasts": sum(
                r["status"] in ["fit_failed", "forecast_failed"] for r in chosen
            ),
            "diverged_forecasts": sum(r["status"] == "diverged" for r in chosen),
            "scores": {},
        }
        if len(chosen) != 45 or len({r["trajectory"] for r in chosen}) != 5:
            raise RuntimeError("Incomplete declared recipe matrix")
        for threshold in ["0.3", "0.5"]:
            values = [r["scores"][threshold]["lyapunov_times"] for r in chosen]
            trajectories = {
                t: statistics.median(
                    r["scores"][threshold]["lyapunov_times"]
                    for r in chosen
                    if r["trajectory"] == t
                )
                for t in sorted({r["trajectory"] for r in chosen})
            }
            record["scores"][threshold] = {
                "primary_median_of_trajectory_medians": statistics.median(
                    trajectories.values()
                ),
                "trajectory_medians": trajectories,
                "trajectory_median_min": min(trajectories.values()),
                "trajectory_median_max": max(trajectories.values()),
                "pooled_median": statistics.median(values),
                "individual_min": min(values),
                "individual_max": max(values),
                "right_censored": sum(
                    r["scores"][threshold]["right_censored"] for r in chosen
                ),
                "per_seed_medians": {
                    str(seed): statistics.median(
                        r["scores"][threshold]["lyapunov_times"]
                        for r in chosen
                        if r["seed"] == seed
                    )
                    for seed in sorted({r["seed"] for r in chosen})
                },
            }
        result.append(record)
    return result


def run(args):
    out = args.directory.resolve()
    protocol = json.loads((out / "preregistered.json").read_text())
    runner = out / "runner/evaluate.py"
    if (
        digest((out / "preregistered.json").read_bytes())
        != json.loads((out / "preregistration-receipt.json").read_text())["sha256"]
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Original preregistration changed")
    if (
        digest(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
        != protocol["runner_manifest"]["evaluate.py"]
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Use the captured frozen evaluator")
    jobs = [("generate", None), ("weights", None)] + [
        ("evaluate", t["id"]) for t in protocol["trajectories"]
    ]
    write(
        out / "launch.json",
        {
            "executable": sys.executable,
            "preregistered_sha256": digest((out / "preregistered.json").read_bytes()),
            "start_condition": condition(),
        },
    )
    for stage, trajectory in jobs:
        name = trajectory or stage
        command = [
            sys.executable,
            str(runner),
            "--stage",
            stage,
            "--directory",
            str(out),
        ]
        if trajectory:
            command += ["--trajectory", trajectory]
        with (out / "processes" / f"{name}.stdout.txt").open("x") as stdout, (
            out / "processes" / f"{name}.stderr.txt"
        ).open("x") as stderr:
            p = subprocess.run(
                command,
                stdout=stdout,
                stderr=stderr,
                timeout=protocol["worker_timeout_seconds"],
            )
        print(name, p.returncode, flush=True)
        if p.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Worker failed; preserve partial evidence: {name}")
    processes = [
        json.loads((out / "processes" / f"{t['id']}.json").read_text())
        for t in protocol["trajectories"]
    ]
    rows = [r for p in processes for r in p["rows"]]
    fits = [f for p in processes for f in p["fits"]]
    if len(rows) != 270 or len(fits) != 90 or len({r["id"] for r in rows}) != 270:
        raise RuntimeError("Incomplete declared matrix")
    write(
        out / "results.json",
        {
            "schema": "resdag-independent-trajectories-results-v1",
            "protocol": protocol,
            "preregistered_sha256": digest((out / "preregistered.json").read_bytes()),
            "data_manifest": json.loads((out / "data-manifest.json").read_text()),
            "weight_manifest": json.loads((out / "weight-manifest.json").read_text()),
            "rows": rows,
            "fits": fits,
            "summaries": summarize(rows),
            "processes": [
                {k: v for k, v in p.items() if k not in ["rows", "fits"]}
                for p in processes
            ],
            "end_condition": condition(),
            "scope": "Accuracy only; no HPO/retuning, all declared cells retained. Potential concurrent parent correctness/package/build workloads; wall/process times are context and not latency evidence.",
        },
    )


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--stage",
        choices=["prepare", "run", "generate", "weights", "evaluate"],
        required=True,
    )
    parser.add_argument("--directory", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--repository", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--source-ref", default="WORKTREE")
    parser.add_argument("--trajectory")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.stage == "prepare":
        if args.repository is None:
            parser.error("--prepare requires --repository")
        prepare(args)
    elif args.stage == "run":
        run(args)
    else:
        worker(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

rc_bench/__init__.py.source:
"""rc_bench — a small, extensible harness for benchmarking reservoir-computing
libraries against each other on identical ESN architectures and data.

The design goal is *re-runnability and extensibility*: every library is wrapped
in an :class:`~rc_bench.adapters.base.Adapter` exposing a uniform
``time_train`` / ``time_forecast`` interface, so adding a new library to the
comparison is a single new adapter file. The runner sweeps a configuration
matrix, the reporter turns the resulting JSON into speedup tables.

See ``benchmarks/README.md`` for usage.
"""

from .config import CONTEXTS, HParams, Point

__all__ = ["HParams", "Point", "CONTEXTS"]

rc_bench/adapters/__init__.py.source:
"""Adapter registry.

``all_adapters()`` returns one instance per benchmarkable configuration
(resdag-CPU, resdag-GPU, reservoirpy, ReservoirComputing.jl, ...). Adding a
library is a new module here plus an entry in ``_REGISTRY``.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from .base import Adapter
from .julia_adapter import ReservoirComputingJLAdapter
from .resdag_adapter import ResdagCPUAdapter, ResdagGPUAdapter
from .reservoirpy_adapter import ReservoirPyAdapter

_REGISTRY: list[type[Adapter]] = [
    ResdagCPUAdapter,
    ResdagGPUAdapter,
    ReservoirPyAdapter,
    ReservoirComputingJLAdapter,
]


def all_adapters(only: list[str] | None = None) -> list[Adapter]:
    """Instantiate every registered adapter, optionally filtered by ``key``."""
    out: list[Adapter] = []
    for cls in _REGISTRY:
        inst = cls()
        if only and inst.key not in only:
            continue
        out.append(inst)
    return out


__all__ = ["Adapter", "all_adapters"]

rc_bench/adapters/julia_adapter.py.source:
"""ReservoirComputing.jl adapter (CPU, via a Julia subprocess).

Cross-language timing is done *inside* Julia (see ``benchmarks/julia/rc_bench.jl``)
so the JVM-like JIT warmup and process startup never enter the measurement. The
shared series is handed over as a raw little-endian float64 file (NumPy ``(T,dim)``
C-order == Julia ``(dim,T)`` column-major), and the worker prints ``TIMES``/``RMSE``
lines we parse back.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

from ..config import HParams, Point
from ..timing import RunResult
from .base import Adapter

_BENCH_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]  # .../benchmarks
_JULIA_PROJECT = _BENCH_DIR / "julia"
_JULIA_SCRIPT = _JULIA_PROJECT / "rc_bench.jl"


class ReservoirComputingJLAdapter(Adapter):
    key = "rcjl"
    label = "ReservoirComputing.jl"
    family = "rcjl"
    device = "cpu"

    @classmethod
    def is_available(cls) -> tuple[bool, str]:
        if shutil.which("julia") is None:
            return False, "julia not on PATH"
        if not _JULIA_SCRIPT.exists():
            return False, f"worker script missing: {_JULIA_SCRIPT}"
        manifest = _JULIA_PROJECT / "Manifest.toml"
        if not manifest.exists():
            return False, (
                "Julia project not instantiated — run: "
                f"julia --project={_JULIA_PROJECT} -e 'using Pkg; Pkg.instantiate()'"
            )
        return True, ""

    def _run(
        self, series: np.ndarray, hp: HParams, point: Point, op: str, repeats: int, warmups: int
    ) -> RunResult:
        self._validate_policy(hp)
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".bin", delete=False) as f:
            data_path = f.name
            np.ascontiguousarray(series, dtype="<f8").tofile(data_path)
        try:
            args = [
                "julia",
                f"--project={_JULIA_PROJECT}",
                str(_JULIA_SCRIPT),
                data_path,
                str(hp.dim),
                str(len(series)),
                str(point.reservoir_size),
                str(point.train_len),
                str(point.warmup),
                str(point.horizon),
                repr(hp.spectral_radius),
                repr(hp.leak_rate),
                repr(hp.connectivity),
                repr(hp.input_scaling),
                repr(hp.ridge),
                str(hp.seed),
                op,
                str(repeats),
                str(warmups),
                str(point.forecast_start),
            ]
            proc = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True)
            if proc.returncode != 0:
                raise RuntimeError(f"julia worker failed (op={op}):\n{proc.stderr[-2000:]}")
            times: list[float] = []
            rmse: float | None = None
            for line in proc.stdout.splitlines():
                if line.startswith("TIMES "):
                    body = line[len("TIMES ") :].strip()
                    times = [float(x) for x in body.split(",") if x]
                elif line.startswith("RMSE "):
                    val = line[len("RMSE ") :].strip()
                    try:
                        f_val = float(val)
                        rmse = None if math.isnan(f_val) else f_val
                    except ValueError:
                        rmse = None
            return RunResult(times=times, rmse=rmse, info={"device": "cpu", "dtype": "float64"})
        finally:
            Path(data_path).unlink(missing_ok=True)

    @staticmethod
    def _validate_policy(hp: HParams) -> None:
        if hp.activation != "tanh":
            raise ValueError("The Julia worker currently supports activation='tanh' only")

    def time_train(self, series, hp, point, repeats, warmups) -> RunResult:
        return self._run(series, hp, point, "train", repeats, warmups)

    def time_forecast(self, series, hp, point, repeats, warmups) -> RunResult:
        return self._run(series, hp, point, "forecast", repeats, warmups)

    def predict_trajectory(self, series, hp, point) -> np.ndarray:
        self._validate_policy(hp)
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".bin", delete=False) as f:
            data_path = f.name
            np.ascontiguousarray(series, dtype="<f8").tofile(data_path)
        out_path = data_path + ".out"
        try:
            args = [
                "julia",
                f"--project={_JULIA_PROJECT}",
                str(_JULIA_SCRIPT),
                data_path,
                str(hp.dim),
                str(len(series)),
                str(point.reservoir_size),
                str(point.train_len),
                str(point.warmup),
                str(point.horizon),
                repr(hp.spectral_radius),
                repr(hp.leak_rate),
                repr(hp.connectivity),
                repr(hp.input_scaling),
                repr(hp.ridge),
                str(hp.seed),
                "trajectory",
                "1",
                "0",
                out_path,
                str(point.forecast_start),
            ]
            proc = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True)
            if proc.returncode != 0:
                raise RuntimeError(f"julia worker failed (trajectory):\n{proc.stderr[-2000:]}")
            # Julia wrote a (dim, horizon) column-major Float64 array; that flat
            # byte order is exactly NumPy (horizon, dim) C-order.
            flat = np.fromfile(out_path, dtype="<f8")
            return flat.reshape(point.horizon, hp.dim)
        finally:
            Path(data_path).unlink(missing_ok=True)
            Path(out_path).unlink(missing_ok=True)

rc_bench/adapters/resdag_adapter.py.source:
"""resdag adapter (CPU and GPU).

Builds a nominally matched ESN: reservoir states -> ridge readout, no input
concatenation, mirroring reservoirpy's ``Reservoir >> Ridge`` and
ReservoirComputing.jl's ``ESN``. CPU runs float64 (to match the NumPy/Julia
baselines); GPU runs float32 (the realistic GPU dtype — consumer cards run
float64 at a small fraction of float32 throughput).
Input connections are dense and recurrent bias is zero across adapters.
Weights are sampled independently; numerical solver behavior can differ.

The readout is :class:`RidgeReadoutLayer` (direct Cholesky solve) — the class
directly comparable to reservoirpy's ``Ridge`` and ReservoirComputing.jl's
direct linear solve, and resdag's own premade default. An earlier version of
this adapter used :class:`CGReadoutLayer`, whose iterative solver silently
under-converges on the near-unregularized (``alpha=1e-6``) Gram at the default
``max_iter=100``; that halved the measured forecast precision (VPT) versus the
direct solve and misrepresented resdag on its most important metric.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np

from ..config import HParams, Point
from ..timing import RunResult, repeat_timed
from .base import Adapter


def _available() -> tuple[bool, str]:
    try:
        import torch  # noqa: F401

        import resdag  # noqa: F401
    except Exception as e:  # pragma: no cover - environment probe
        return False, f"import failed: {e}"
    return True, ""


class _ResdagBase(Adapter):
    family = "resdag"
    _torch_device = "cpu"
    _dtype_name = "float64"
    # Drive the autoregressive forecast through the torch.compile (cudagraph)
    # path. Worth it on GPU, where per-step kernel-launch overhead — not the
    # tiny matmul — dominates a long closed-loop forecast; on CPU the eager flat
    # step is already launch-free, so leave it off there.
    _compile_forecast = False

    @classmethod
    def is_available(cls) -> tuple[bool, str]:
        ok, reason = _available()
        if not ok:
            return ok, reason
        if cls._torch_device == "cuda":
            import torch

            if not torch.cuda.is_available():
                return False, "CUDA not available"
        return True, ""

    def _build(self, hp: HParams, point: Point):
        import pytorch_symbolic as ps
        import torch

        from resdag import ESNModel
        from resdag.layers import ESNLayer
        from resdag.layers.readouts import RidgeReadoutLayer

        dtype = torch.float64 if self._dtype_name == "float64" else torch.float32

        with torch.device(self._torch_device):
            inp = ps.Input((1, hp.dim), dtype=dtype)
            res = ESNLayer(
                reservoir_size=point.reservoir_size,
                feedback_size=hp.dim,
                bias=False,
                spectral_radius=hp.spectral_radius,
                leak_rate=hp.leak_rate,
                activation=hp.activation,
                topology=("erdos_renyi", {"p": hp.connectivity}),
                feedback_initializer=("uniform", {"input_scaling": hp.input_scaling}),
                seed=hp.seed,
                device=self._torch_device,
                dtype=dtype,
            )(inp)
            readout = RidgeReadoutLayer(
                point.reservoir_size, hp.dim, alpha=hp.ridge, bias=False, name="output"
            ).to(device=self._torch_device, dtype=dtype)
            model = ESNModel(inp, readout(res))
        return model, dtype

    def _tensor(self, arr: np.ndarray, dtype):
        import torch

        return torch.as_tensor(arr, dtype=dtype, device=self._torch_device).unsqueeze(0)

    def _sync(self):
        if self._torch_device == "cuda":
            import torch

            torch.cuda.synchronize()

    def _fit(self, model, dtype, series: np.ndarray, point: Point):
        from resdag.training import ESNTrainer

        x_all, y_all = self._train_window(series, point)
        warm = self._tensor(x_all[: point.warmup], dtype)
        x = self._tensor(x_all[point.warmup :], dtype)
        y = self._tensor(y_all[point.warmup :], dtype)
        ESNTrainer(model).fit(warmup_inputs=(warm,), train_inputs=(x,), targets={"output": y})

    def time_train(self, series, hp, point, repeats, warmups) -> RunResult:
        def setup():
            return self._build(hp, point)

        def op(ctx):
            model, dtype = ctx
            self._fit(model, dtype, series, point)
            return None

        times, _ = repeat_timed(setup, op, repeats, warmups, sync=self._sync)
        return RunResult(
            times=times, info={"device": self._torch_device, "dtype": self._dtype_name}
        )

    def time_forecast(self, series, hp, point, repeats, warmups) -> RunResult:
        import torch

        model, dtype = self._build(hp, point)
        self._fit(model, dtype, series, point)
        warm = self._tensor(self._forecast_history(series, point), dtype)

        def setup():
            model.reset_reservoirs()
            return model

        def op(m):
            with torch.no_grad():
                return m.forecast(warm, horizon=point.horizon, compile=self._compile_forecast)

        times, last = repeat_timed(setup, op, repeats, warmups, sync=self._sync)

        rmse = None
        if last is not None:
            truth = self._forecast_truth(series, point)
            pred = last.squeeze(0).detach().cpu().numpy()[: len(truth)]
            n = min(len(truth), len(pred), 200)  # short-horizon sanity window
            if n > 0:
                rmse = float(np.sqrt(np.mean((pred[:n] - truth[:n]) ** 2)))
        return RunResult(
            times=times, rmse=rmse, info={"device": self._torch_device, "dtype": self._dtype_name}
        )

    def predict_trajectory(self, series, hp, point) -> np.ndarray:
        import torch

        model, dtype = self._build(hp, point)
        self._fit(model, dtype, series, point)
        warm = self._tensor(self._forecast_history(series, point), dtype)
        model.reset_reservoirs()
        with torch.no_grad():
            out = model.forecast(warm, horizon=point.horizon)
        return out.squeeze(0).detach().cpu().numpy().astype(np.float64)


class ResdagCPUAdapter(_ResdagBase):
    key = "resdag-cpu"
    label = "resdag (CPU)"
    _torch_device = "cpu"
    _dtype_name = "float64"


class ResdagGPUAdapter(_ResdagBase):
    key = "resdag-gpu"
    label = "resdag (GPU)"
    _torch_device = "cuda"
    _dtype_name = "float32"
    _compile_forecast = True
